english: Money leaves an account and comes back to it within 7 days, through 2 to 5 transfers. Every hop moves nearly the same amount (within 20% of the previous hop) with patient gaps (fully true to 1 day, false by 5 days). All conditions must hold; fire at 0.5.
motif:
term patient = trapezoid(0h, 0h, 24h, 120h)

motif cand {
  match (a:account) -[e:transfer*2..5]-> (a:account)
  where e is time_ordered and span(e) <= 7d
  soft each e: e.gap is patient and each e: e.amount ~= prev.amount within 20%
  score min
  emit when score >= 0.5
}
